whenItMayNotFit.heading: When this path may not fit as well

If your business is located in South Texas (San Antonio or Laredo), review those specific metro resource pages.

commonQuestions.question: Which SBA district office covers El Paso?
commonQuestions.answer: The SBA El Paso District Office serves El Paso and 12 West Texas counties.

commonQuestions.question: Where can I get free SBA loan application help in El Paso?
commonQuestions.answer: The El Paso Community College SBDC provides free business consulting and loan prep assistance.

commonQuestions.question: What is the difference between SBA 7(a) and 504 loans for El Paso businesses?
commonQuestions.answer: SBA 7(a) offers up to $5M for general working capital, debt refinance, or acquisitions. SBA 504 is specialized for commercial real estate and industrial space.

commonQuestions.question: Does Fund44 issue SBA loans directly in El Paso?
commonQuestions.answer: No. Fund44 is an educational technology marketplace, not a lender. Loans are issued by third-party SBA participating lenders.
